description.en: Slides a character to a position over a number of frames, with no walk or run motion and no final rotation: CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG(_hdl, [x, y, z], _frame, 0). Only the first three values of _mvPos are used. Wait for the end with WaitEvLowMdlMoving.
Target [x, y, z] (a fourth value is ignored).
Duration of the move in frames.

examples.case: Moving the player character while the camera follows (real usage, from ev42010200.nut)
